features: AsyncResource instance/static bindings preserve the call receiver when thisArg is undefined, explicit null/falsy receivers, arguments and original function arity. Real resource scope restores execution and storage state when callbacks throw.

AsyncLocalStorage.bind captures a real AsyncResource and delegates through its scope, preserving receiver, arity, current resource identity and hooks. Existing extra argument binding behavior is retained.

Unchanged bind/snapshot originals and existing events, resource and timer originals pass with separately counted process checks. Native controls assert identity, explicit/omitted receivers and exception restoration.
limitations: This validates fifteen original files, 93 test cases and eleven process checks; full Bun-suite parity is not established. Native corpus negative controls remain negative and are retained rather than counted as successes.

General Promise lifecycle/continuation identity and unconnected native producers remain #877. Internal context-frame semantics remain #871/#856. Directory descriptors, iterator lifetime, rename identity and teardown remain #878; no directory implementation was changed in this batch.
Earlier performance #874/#872 failures were not rerun. Corpus #876, performance #869/#873, HTTPS #875/#532, full suite and Release/ASAN/all-platform verification remain open under #66.

Node reference confirmed disabled storage invalidates captured stores; no disable/snapshot mutation change is claimed. Pickier reports two existing warnings and zero errors. Native ABI code was unchanged and its broader controls were not rerun.
